news.headline: Gunman who killed at least six people in Krakow had ‘far-right’ views, Polish government says
news.summary: A gunman reportedly "fascinated by far-right ideologies" shot and killed at least six people and wounded more than a dozen more in Krakow’s main market square on Saturday, Polish authorities said. Three more bodies were later found at the home of the gunman, who was wounded and taken into custody.
